tour.title: Start with runnable surfaces
tour.description: GPS has a NestJS API, a portal web app, a newer @gps/gps web app, and e2e projects for API and portal verification.

tour.title: Follow the API feature composition
tour.description: The API app composes server feature libraries for academics, attendance, billing, communications, documents, guardians, exams, homework, admissions, RBAC, schools, staff, students, lifecycle, tenants, timetable, and transport.

tour.title: Follow the portal composition
tour.description: The portal app composes web feature libraries, shared auth, data access HTTP, query, router, and UI packages.

tour.title: Understand the data foundation
tour.description: Server features depend on shared data-access-db and data-access-prisma, which wraps the generated Prisma client.
